title: Smart Switch (LEO)
description: LEO — a local-first smart-home switch and hub with its own MQTT broker, web dashboard and a companion Android app. Runs entirely on your network, no cloud.
highlight: Fully offline — its own broker, mDNS clustering and a glassmorphic app.

title: Smart Tank Monitor (AquaNode)
description: A Wi-Fi water-tank monitor — ultrasonic level sensing, a live dashboard, colour LED status and push alerts, with on-device logging.
highlight: Live dashboard updated in real time over Server-Sent Events.

title: Autonomous RoboDog
description: A security quadruped that detects and follows a recognised face in real time using on-board computer vision.
highlight: Basis of the IEEE NQComp-2026 research paper (MIT Manipal).

title: Interactive Humanoid
description: An interactive humanoid robot that listens, understands and replies with real-time, lip-synced speech.
highlight: Real-time speech recognition with lip-synced response.

title: WALL-E Build
description: A WALL-E–inspired animatronic build with motion and personality, presented at the Innovative Project Expo.

title: Path Finder Bot
description: An obstacle-avoiding robot that works out a route around barriers in real time.

title: Line Follower Bot
description: An autonomous robot that follows a marked track using IR sensors and a tuned control loop.

title: AI-Driven Smart Traffic Management
description: A computer-vision system that detects traffic flow and optimises signal timing to ease congestion.

title: Smart Traffic System
description: A model traffic-control system that adapts signal timing to live road conditions using sensors.

title: Maker Space Sign Board
description: A programmable LED sign board built for the campus Maker Space, with addressable lighting effects.

title: Cyber Attack Demonstration
description: An educational demonstration of common attack techniques and their defences, built to teach safe security practices.

title: DIY Bluetooth Speaker
description: A hand-built portable Bluetooth speaker — amplifier, custom enclosure and battery, assembled and tuned end to end.

title: DIY Power Bank
description: A custom USB power bank built around 18650 cells with a boost converter and charge-protection circuit.
